scope: Metal RAW Bayer bilinear reconstruction of analytical affine color fields

new_control.oracle: Analytical affine source fields and retained independent camera transform; no shader sampler reused

limitations: Synthetic affine fields qualify interior bilinear reconstruction only, not arbitrary scene demosaic quality
Sensor boundary clamping, AHD GPU implementation, physical HDR luminance and all real-camera RAW layouts are not qualified by this control
